presentation.label: HOWL
presentation.summary: A Total Sonic Annihilation-style feedback loop that self-oscillates on demand.
presentation.overview: A Total Sonic Annihilation-style feedback loop that self-oscillates on demand.
highlights: Use short notes and bring feedback up gradually to hear when it starts sustaining.
